name: GMV Winlet 1000 Crawler
summary: Fully hydraulic tracked glazing robot that lifts glass and windows of up to 1,000 kg to 4.5 m and levels itself automatically on slopes, so it works on rough ground and stairs without outriggers. Made by GMV A/S in Denmark; the ER version with longer reach is a separate model.

germany.statusNote: GMV A/S (Bredsten, Denmark) sells Winlet glazing robots direct, with German-language product pages and a quote form. The Winlet range starts at EUR 24,600 ("Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-"); which model this applies to and whether it is net is not stated. No German dealer is named.

sellers.name: GMV A/S
sellers.note: Office and production: Industriparken 1, DK-7182 Bredsten (sales: Sales@gmvas.dk). German quote form on the product page; the Winlet overview page says "Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-" without naming the model.

specs.label: Automatic levelling
specs.quote: Winlet 1000 Crawler wird sich sich automatisch die längs verlaufenden Neigungen bis zu 15° (27 %) sowie quer verlaufenden Neigungen bis zu 14° (25 %) anpassen

notes: Maker says it works anywhere in terrain and on stairs with low ground pressure and never needs outriggers (roughGround and stairs are maker claims).
